formulas.units: ms, bytes, decimal GB/s and TFLOP/s; BF16=2 bytes; FMA=2 FLOPs
formulas.prefill_gemm: F=2*P_linear*S; D=2*P_linear+a_prefill*L*h*S; optional last-token head adds 2*P_head to F,D
formulas.prefill_attention: F=4*L*d_q*S*S; D=2*S*(2*d_q+2*d_kv)*L; full square, not causal triangle
formulas.decode_attention: F=4*L*B*ctx*d_q; D=4*L*B*ctx*d_kv; ctx includes current position
formulas.step_time: t_step_ms=sum(component.t_ms)+t_fixed_ms; global AI is display only
formulas.naive_attention: D_naive=D_flash+4*L*q_heads*S*S; same declared F; asymptotic AI=head_dim
formulas.layernorm: S=2048,h=1024; F=4*S*h; D=4*S*h; affine/reduction extras omitted teaching count

原始预测时间戳不证明测量前已落盘；源脚本在全部留出测量结束后统一保存，缺少独立留出测量起止时间。

课程 B/C 近似表的 reconciliation 保留 nominal 基线；不能用校准后结果反标近似表的计数正确性。
